in_sanskrit.name: Rachit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Vishnu's Leap
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rachit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Rachit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rachas' which means 'to leap'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have taken a leap to preserve the universe. The name Rachit is thus a reminder of Lord Vishnu's divine intervention and protection.
